name: B10-0254/2025 (Renew) – Violations of religious freedom in Tibet
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on China to stop its policies in Tibet that it says suppress Tibetan Buddhism, language and culture. It asks China to allow people to practise their religion freely and to release religious and political prisoners, including the Panchen Lama. It also asks the European Union and its member states to consider sanctions on Chinese officials linked to human rights abuses in Tibet, to demand an independent investigation into the death of Tibetan Buddhist leader Tulku Hungkar Dorje, and to raise Tibet at every dialogue with China.

- The Parliament asks the EU to consider sanctions on Chinese officials over Tibet; no sanctions are decided yet.
- It calls on China to free prisoners and stop suppressing religion; this affects Tibetans and the Chinese government.
- It asks the EU to raise Tibet in talks with China and to investigate the death of Tulku Hungkar Dorje.
